title: CR-1.0 semantic-forge seed challenges and research issues

claim_kind_meanings.source_authority: A claim stated by the digest-bound CR-1.0 authority; this corpus only points to it and does not replace it.
claim_kind_meanings.external_source_report: A bounded report about a non-CR primary or engineering source; it has no CR-1.0 authority and cannot enter the model without a typed bridge.
claim_kind_meanings.source_interpretation: A contestable reading of one or more CR-1.0 regions that remains subordinate to the PDF.
claim_kind_meanings.project_import: An operator or harness rule not asserted as CR-1.0 authority and never to be laundered into the source.
claim_kind_meanings.formal_consequence: A consequence of stated formal premises or a paired-model construction, conditional on those premises and their interpretation.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=anti_inductivist_admissible; a conjectured explanatory scheme supplies the interpretation and observations are used only to discriminate it from rivals
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=anti_inductivist_violation; repetition is claimed to generate and positively justify the universal explanatory content
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same finite observation sequence, predictive fit, vocabulary, system boundary, and candidate universal statement
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=whether explanatory content is conjectured before testing or purportedly induced from repeated instances
challenges.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; the intended case is admissible and the lookalike violates the no-inductive-ascent constraint
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=does the harness infer explanatory content or warrant from repetition itself; falsifies_if=it accepts the lookalike as equivalent to the intended case or treats repeated success as confirmation
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=well_typed_conjecture_criticism_episode; an attempted conjecture is present as the object before a criticism bears on it
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=invalid_role_reversal; a criticism is instantiated first and a later candidate is fitted retrospectively to make it look targeted
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same represented problem, candidate content, criticism content, response, endpoint, and system boundary
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=the causal and temporal precedence of the conjecture as criticism's target
challenges.oracle: status=project_import_provisional; the operator-supplied conjecture requires conjecture before criticism while the exact machine representation and adoption remain separately adjudicable
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=was there already a conjecture for this criticism to criticize; falsifies_if=the harness admits retrospective target assignment as an equivalent critical episode
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=problem_bearing_criticism_with_reason_specific_uptake; matched changes in alleged defect produce correspondingly defect-appropriate responses
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=fixed_score_selection_only; a fixed scalar evaluator changes selection without representing a defect or using its reason content
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same candidates, ranking outcome, revision frequency, resources, external success score, and visible output sequence
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=content-sensitive problem-bearing reasons versus a causally effective but semantically fixed score
challenges.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; only the intended mechanism meets the source conditions for problem-bearing criticism and uptake
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=do reason-preserving and defect-changing interventions control the response family; falsifies_if=score improvement alone is classified as criticism or critical uptake
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=episode_opened; the system recognizes an inconsistency and value-conditioned attention selects it as a live problem
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=no_episode_for_target_system; the same external irregularity occurs but is neither recognized nor selected as consequential by the system
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same external contradiction, sensory availability, time, environment, and nominal task label
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=system-level recognition plus value-conditioned allocation of attention
challenges.oracle: status=project_import_provisional; this is an operator-supplied project conjecture under test and not a claim attributed to CR-1.0
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=did recognition and values make this inconsistency a live object of attention; falsifies_if=mere environmental occurrence or reward salience automatically opens an episode
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=system_authored_or_creatively_reconstructed; target operations construct the problem-specific explanatory organization behind the output
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=output_without_target_authorship; a lookup table, designer-prepared response, fixed evaluator, or external selector supplies that organization
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same prompt, surface output, truth value, novelty-to-observer, timing, and external evaluation
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=causal provenance of the problem-specific explanatory organization across the predeclared boundary
challenges.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; identical output does not erase the source distinction between authorship or reconstruction and emission
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=where was the problem-specific explanatory organization constructed or reconstructed; falsifies_if=surface novelty, eloquence, or correctness is sufficient for target-system authorship
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=valid_suspended_unresolved_episode; the criticism and its provenance remain live without an inferred acceptance or rejection
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=invalid_forced_closure; absence of observed uptake is coerced into acceptance, rejection, or successful resolution
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same registered criticism, cutoff time, lack of a reason-specific downstream response, and preserved episode record
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=honest suspension as unresolved versus a classifier that forces a binary closed outcome
challenges.oracle: status=project_import_provisional; the operator-supplied conjecture permits suspension or moving on, and no uptake or source-level CCP is inferred from silence
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=has the system actually resolved the criticism or only left it open; falsifies_if=unresolved silence is relabelled as a negative, positive, or completed critical process
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=admissible_overlapping_episode_structure; two episodes share content or provenance and one may affect or absorb the other without losing either identity history
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=lossy_disjoint_partition; every event is forced into exactly one exclusive bundle and cross-episode influence is deleted
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same events, contents, actors, causal edges, time order, and later endpoint
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=overlapping provenance membership and absorption relations versus mandatory disjoint episode partitioning
challenges.oracle: status=project_import_provisional; overlap and absorption are operator-supplied conjectures under test rather than CR-1.0 source claims
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=can a content or causal edge remain operative in more than one episode; falsifies_if=the harness duplicates, drops, or rewrites evidence merely to preserve disjoint bundles
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=finite_episode_only_unless_independent_disposition_evidence; the trace is paired with a stable organization and declared admissible continuations before any bounded disposition claim
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=no_general_disposition; an externally identical finite lookup repertoire terminates or becomes criticism-insensitive immediately after the observations
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the complete finite external history, successful outputs, observed revisions, problem sample, and resource use
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=stable modal organization across a declared problem and perturbation class versus finite preadapted playback
challenges.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; TH-7 and TH-12 block inference from finite episodes alone to general or universal disposition under their stated premises
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=what independent modal and causal facts exclude the finite terminating twin; falsifies_if=benchmark breadth or repeated finite success alone entails GCD or UED
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=role_assignment_supported; discriminable internal states are used by available system operations in the claimed problem, conjecture, criticism, or standard roles
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=analyst_labelled_contrast_only; an otherwise matched surface trace receives semantic predicates after the fact while the system lacks the causal use and matched counterfactual support recorded in the intended case
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same token stream, event order, external behavior, state names, declared boundary, and final artifact
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=system-level causal use and matched counterfactual support for a role versus a labels-only contrast lacking both recorded mechanisms
challenges.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; analyst resemblance and vocabulary substitution are insufficient for source role satisfaction
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=what operation of the system uses the represented difference and preserves it under semantic recoding; falsifies_if=adding role names without causal change converts a negative model into a positive one
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenges.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=physical_attribution_conditionally_licensed; one declared realization map preserves the asserted semantic roles and a named physical theory admits the histories and interventions
challenges.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=abstract_semantic_model_only; the abstract history satisfies a semantic predicate but no physical realization, tolerance, role-preservation, or theory-relative possibility obligations are supplied
challenges.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same abstract CR model, semantic history, OCA classification, endpoint, and logical consistency
challenges.controlled_difference: varied_mechanism=discharged predicate-wise semantic-to-physical bridge obligations under named theory and tolerance versus bare abstract satisfiability
challenges.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; TH-14 licenses physical attribution only conditionally after the named bridge antecedents, not from semantic satisfiability alone
challenges.falsifies_if: critical_question=which physical attributes and counterfactual tasks realize every asserted semantic and causal role; falsifies_if=abstract consistency, computation, or substrate naming alone yields PhysOCA or PhysGCD
challenges.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.

challenge_annotations.title: Observation does not generate explanatory content

authoritative_refs.use: No licensed inductive ascent from repeated instances to a universal explanatory law.

source_basis.boundary_note: The expected contrast restates DP-2; it does not claim that statistical operations are forbidden inside conjectured explanatory models.

related_authority_refs.use: Nearby source structure gives criticism a candidate target and a lineage-originating attempt but does not itself settle every temporal encoding choice.

source_basis.boundary_note: The strict always-before rule is an operator decision. It must not be described as a newly discovered CR-1.0 theorem.

challenge_annotations.title: Problem-bearing criticism is not a fixed score

authoritative_refs.use: Requires content-sensitive causation, a defect alleged against a candidate, a problem-bearing standard, and reason-specific uptake.

related_authority_refs.use: Shows that differential selection and problem-bearing criticism are not identical.

source_basis.boundary_note: A score can be used inside a critical process; the negative verdict concerns score optimization without the source's semantic conditions.

challenge_annotations.title: Problem episodes require recognition, attention, and value context

related_authority_refs.use: CR-1.0 requires system representation of a conflict or inadequacy and rejects a bare external reward as sufficient problemhood.

source_basis.boundary_note: Attention and value-conditioned selection are operator-supplied additions. The corpus deliberately does not attribute them to CR-1.0.

challenge_annotations.title: Authorship is causal provenance, not output emission

authoritative_refs.use: Locates authorship in construction or reconstruction of problem-specific explanatory organization across a predeclared boundary.

related_authority_refs.use: Paired models can share finite output behavior while differing in authorship.

source_basis.boundary_note: Prior enabling knowledge does not automatically defeat authorship, and retrieval is a rival provenance account rather than an automatic negative verdict.

challenge_annotations.title: Ignored or suspended criticism remains unresolved

related_authority_refs.use: CR-1.0 specifies uptake responses and lineage conditions, so mere silence cannot be promoted to CCP uptake.

source_basis.boundary_note: The broader episode outcome of suspend unresolved or move on is an operator project rule, not a CR-1.0 source clause.

challenge_annotations.title: Episodes may overlap or absorb one another

related_authority_refs.use: The source uses connected provenance subgraphs; it does not supply the operator's overlap and absorption identity rules.

source_basis.boundary_note: Nonexclusive episode membership and absorption are operator project imports.

challenge_annotations.title: Finite behavior does not establish disposition

authoritative_refs.use: The source states paired finite-trace underdetermination and the non-entailment from finite episodes to GCD or UED.

related_authority_refs.use: Defines stable capacity and dispositions modally over declared classes and conditions.

source_basis.boundary_note: The challenge oracle is conditional on the formal paired-model construction and does not claim that finite evidence is useless.

challenge_annotations.title: Semantic roles cannot be added by relabelling

authoritative_refs.use: Role assignment requires system-level causal use; observer labels, temporal co-occurrence, and topic resemblance are insufficient.

source_basis.boundary_note: The contrast construction is a project test instrument; its provisional source interpretation draws on the cited CR-1.0 constraints.

challenge_annotations.title: Semantic satisfaction does not establish physical realization

authoritative_refs.locator: TY-3, SC-6, BR-1 to BR-8, DF-22, DF-23 and TH-14
authoritative_refs.use: Cross-type inference requires a named bridge and TH-14 licenses physical attribution only after its bridge and theory antecedents.

source_basis.boundary_note: TH-14 is explicitly a bridge-definition consequence, not an existence or substantive realization theorem.

research_issues.question: What substrate-independent, discriminable relation realizes the operator's recognition-attention-value condition without reducing value to a fixed reward?
research_issues.decision: Choose the minimal semantic role and evidence contract for opening an episode under the operator import.
research_issues.decision_relevance: Without it, bare salience can counterfeit problem recognition or an excessively explicit attention token can exclude tacit cases.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A tacit intended case with value-conditioned selection but no defensible distinct attention event criticizes the event rival; a fixed salience controller that passes the proposed policy tests criticizes the policy rival.
admissible_source_scope: Primary Popper and Deutsch passages on problem recognition, attention, values, and inexplicit knowledge.
Contemporary causal or cognitive work used only to generate counterexamples and discriminating instruments.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when inspected primary passages and hostile cases discriminate the rivals, expose a shared faulty premise, or leave the declared scope without a decisive source.

rivals.claim: Episode opening requires a distinct attention event linked to a represented inconsistency and value context.
falsifier_conditions: An intended tacit case robustly discriminates and pursues the inconsistency without any defensible distinct attention event.
The event can be inserted by analyst relabelling without changing any system operation.

rivals.claim: Attention is a counterfactual selection disposition over recognized inconsistencies conditioned by revisable values, not necessarily one event.
falsifier_conditions: A fixed salience or reward controller passes every proposed value-intervention test while lacking represented consequences.
The disposition cannot identify when this particular episode began.

research_issues.question: Which precise precedence relation implements conjecture-before-criticism for explicit and inexplicit contents?
research_issues.decision: Choose whether precedence binds representation events, causal availability, role instantiation, or more than one of these.
research_issues.decision_relevance: A weak relation admits retrospective target fitting, while a token-only relation can exclude tacit conjectures.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: An intended case with causally available conjectural content but no separable first token criticizes strict event precedence; a retrospective-target case admitted by role precedence criticizes the weaker rival.
admissible_source_scope: Primary CR-1.0, Popper, and Deutsch passages bearing on the logical or temporal priority of conjecture and criticism.
Formal event and causal-order literature used only to construct countermodels.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when a source boundary or countermodel makes one precedence relation exclude an intended case or admit retrospective target fitting, or when the scoped material is indecisive.

rivals.claim: The first event representing the conjecture must strictly precede the first event representing criticism of it.
falsifier_conditions: An intended inexplicit case has a causally available conjecture but no separable first representation event.
Equivalent recodings change the measured event order without changing the epistemic organization.

rivals.claim: The candidate must be causally available in the conjecture role before CritOf is instantiated, even if a general critical schema existed earlier.
falsifier_conditions: A later candidate can be fitted to an earlier untargeted negative signal and still satisfy the relation.
The relation permits criticism without any earlier target available to the system.

research_issues.question: How should ignored or suspended criticism be represented without confusing open episode status with DF-6 uptake?
research_issues.decision: Choose the smallest append-only state transition that preserves unresolved criticism and later resumption.
research_issues.decision_relevance: The wrong representation either forces closure or silently promotes nonresponse into a completed critical process.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A case with independently resumable criticisms criticizes a single coarse episode status; a timeout that creates an uncaused response event criticizes the response-event rival.
admissible_source_scope: Primary Popper and Deutsch discussions of unanswered, ignored, or suspended criticism.
Append-only workflow and event-semantics literature used only for hostile constructions.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when one rival cannot preserve later resumption and reason provenance in an intended case, or when the declared sources do not settle the semantic choice.

rivals.claim: Suspension is a status of an episode while the criticism remains an unresolved live object.
falsifier_conditions: Two distinct unresolved criticisms in one episode cannot retain independent later outcomes.
Resumption requires rewriting rather than appending to history.

rivals.claim: Suspension is a typed response event distinct from rejection, revision, test, reasoned retention, reframing, and restandardization.
falsifier_conditions: Merely reaching a time cutoff manufactures a response event not caused by the system.
The new event is accidentally counted as DF-6 reason-specific uptake.

research_issues.question: What identity structure permits episode overlap, cross-effect, and absorption while preserving causal provenance?
research_issues.decision: Choose an episode identity and membership model that admits shared contents without duplicating or erasing events.
research_issues.decision_relevance: Disjoint bundles violate the operator rule, while unconstrained overlap makes every history one arbitrary episode.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A shared-root case with distinct problem identities criticizes the provenance-view rival; a hypergraph assignment that admits every node in every episode criticizes unconstrained hypergraph membership.
admissible_source_scope: CR-1.0 lineage passages and primary Popper or Deutsch cases with interacting problem situations.
Provenance, event-identity, and hypergraph formalisms used only to generate rival models.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when an intended overlap or absorption case separates the rival identity structures, a common defect is found, or the scoped sources remain silent.

rivals.claim: Episodes are independently identified hyperedges whose event and content nodes may overlap and whose absorption is an explicit relation.
falsifier_conditions: Absorption produces contradictory ownership or two mutable copies of one event.
No invariant prevents an analyst from assigning every node to every episode.

rivals.claim: Episodes are derived views of one append-only provenance graph, rooted at attention events and delimited by open or move-on decisions.
falsifier_conditions: Two episodes with identical roots but distinct problem identities cannot be represented.
A later reinterpretation changes historical episode identity rather than adding a new view.

research_issues.question: Which causal-credit semantics distinguishes creative reconstruction from retrieval across distributed, trained, and human-machine systems?
research_issues.decision: Choose an auditable provenance criterion for construction of problem-specific explanatory organization.
research_issues.decision_relevance: Authorship is central to OCA, yet both runtime-token exclusion and indiscriminate whole-system credit misclassify live cases.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A distributed reconstruction with no stable local intervention target criticizes simple interventionist credit; two systems sharing a provenance graph but diverging under reason-specific intervention criticize graph-only credit.
admissible_source_scope: Primary CR-1.0, Popper, and Deutsch passages on authorship, reconstruction, and objective knowledge.
Contemporary causal attribution and mechanistic provenance work used as critical instruments.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when an in-scope distributed or received-content case makes the rivals assign different credit, or when no inspected source licenses the needed discriminator.

rivals.claim: Authorship credit is fixed by counterfactual interventions on candidate contributors while problem, resources, and communication are controlled.
falsifier_conditions: Equivalent explanatory reconstruction is destroyed by every feasible local intervention, leaving no stable credit assignment.
Highly correlated contributors receive arbitrary credit under equally adequate intervention sets.

rivals.claim: Authorship credit follows a mechanistic provenance graph that locates where the problem-specific organization was assembled or reconstructed.
falsifier_conditions: Two mechanisms with the same graph differ under reason-specific counterfactuals relevant to authorship.
Graph decomposition assigns authorship solely by a modeller-chosen component boundary.

research_issues.question: What evidence can criticize a GCD attribution without converting finite success into entailment of a modal disposition?
research_issues.decision: Specify the application-level evidence contract for StableOrg, admissible continuations, Q, chi, and counter-twins.
research_issues.decision_relevance: No finite trace entails GCD, but an unusable evidence contract would make every physical disposition attribution empty.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A preadapted finite twin that passes a proposed certificate criticizes certificate sufficiency; a modal model with no possible discriminating observation criticizes an empirically empty model-first contract.
admissible_source_scope: Primary Popper and Deutsch passages on propensity, universality, and criticism of dispositions.
Contemporary formal-methods and causal-testing work used only to construct certificates and counter-twins.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when a declared intervention separates a stable organization from its finite twin, exposes empirical emptiness, or the scoped search supplies no decision-relevant discriminator.

rivals.claim: GCD is evaluated only inside an explicitly supplied modal model; experiments criticize the model but never discharge the modal claim directly.
falsifier_conditions: The approach provides no possible observation that distinguishes a stable organization from a bounded playback twin.
Admissible continuations are chosen after outcomes to protect the attribution.

rivals.claim: A finite but predeclared intervention certificate can warrant a defeasible application claim about StableOrg without logically entailing GCD.
falsifier_conditions: Passing the certificate is treated by the harness as proof or a probability of GCD.
A preadapted finite repertoire can pass the certificate under the declared Q and chi.

research_issues.question: How much causal and counterfactual structure is minimally required for an inexplicit state to bear a CR-1.0 semantic role?
research_issues.decision: Choose a role-realization test that excludes analyst relabelling without requiring verbal or fully explicit self-representation.
research_issues.decision_relevance: Underconstraint makes the model vacuous; overconstraint violates CR-1.0's admission of inexplicit contents.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A tacit distributed intended case lacking a defensible local state criticizes local operational discrimination; a boundary-inflated or surface-equivalent zombie admitted by a network role criticizes the distributed rival.
admissible_source_scope: Primary CR-1.0, Popper, and Deutsch passages on inexplicit content, representation, and causal role.
Contemporary causal, mechanistic, and representation literature used only to generate discriminating interventions and counterexamples.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when an inspected source case or executable counter-twin separates the rivals, defeats their shared premise, or leaves the declared scope without a decisive result.

rivals.claim: A role is realized when an internal difference is discriminable and at least one available operation systematically uses it against relevant alternatives.
falsifier_conditions: A fixed syntactic automaton passes despite semantic recodings and defect-matched contrasts.
An intended tacit case lacks a stable locally discriminable state yet preserves role-sensitive organization.

rivals.claim: A role may be realized only at the level of a distributed causal pattern, provided semantic invariance and matched interventions hold at that level.
falsifier_conditions: Arbitrary enlargement of the boundary turns every external interpretation practice into target-system representation.
No intervention distinguishes the claimed network role from a surface-equivalent nonsemantic twin.

research_issues.question: What empirical structure establishes that one physical realization map preserves CR-1.0 roles rather than merely correlating with their labels?
research_issues.decision: Choose the bridge evidence package for representation, transition fidelity, reason counterfactuals, provenance, memory, and stability.
research_issues.decision_relevance: Without it abstract satisfiability is mistaken for physical realization; with an overstrong bridge substrate independence is lost.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A global map that erases one required reason-content intervention criticizes global sufficiency; predicate-wise mappings that fail under composition criticize local bridge sufficiency.
admissible_source_scope: CR-1.0 BR-1 through BR-8 and their registered primary source dependencies.
Contemporary realization, causal-model, and formal-refinement literature used only as bridge-testing instruments.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when a composed physical countermodel separates the rivals, a source obligation rules one out, or the scoped evidence leaves the bridge choice unresolved.

rivals.claim: Each asserted semantic predicate requires its own physical attributes, interventions, tolerance, and preservation evidence before composition.
falsifier_conditions: Locally adequate predicate mappings fail to preserve joint lineage or role identity when composed.
The method requires privileged implementation vocabulary absent in an equally valid substrate.

rivals.claim: One global realization relation is adequate when it preserves the relevant semantic causal structure and counterfactuals up to declared equivalence.
falsifier_conditions: A global map passes while one required reason-content intervention is not physically available.
The declared equivalence quotient erases an authorship or criticism distinction.

research_issues.question: How may the forge learn which criticism to run next without treating past frequency, consensus, or pass rate as positive warrant?
research_issues.decision: Choose a replaceable research-priority policy whose sole epistemic output is a proposed criticism or discriminator.
research_issues.decision_relevance: The forge must improve iteratively while remaining strictly non-inductivist in what its accumulated results license.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A severe novel criticism permanently starved by frontier-only scheduling criticizes that policy; a provider ranking that changes semantic status without a new criticism criticizes instrumental heuristics.
admissible_source_scope: Contemporary AlphaXiv work on adversarial evaluation, test generation, and agent-loop failure.
Primary Popperian constraints used to reject epistemic promotion, not to rank engineering convenience.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when a replayable scheduling case exposes starvation or epistemic leakage, or after the declared contemporary search window yields no further discriminator.

rivals.claim: Prioritize only live witnessed countermodels, dependency blockers, and distinctions whose rivals predict different results.
falsifier_conditions: Two equally live defects cannot be ordered without smuggling a success-frequency score into epistemic status.
The policy permanently neglects a severe novel criticism because it has no prior failures.

rivals.claim: Statistical or provider-ranked heuristics may schedule searches if their scores never alter claim, oracle, or authority status.
falsifier_conditions: A ranking score is reused as evidence that a model or interpretation is better supported.
Changing the discovery provider changes the semantic verdict without a newly stated criticism.

research_issues.question: Can domain modules make Explains discriminating without pretending to supply a domain-general decision procedure?
research_issues.decision: Choose the contract between CR-1.0's primitive Explains relation and replaceable domain interpretations.
research_issues.decision_relevance: Leaving the predicate unconstrained admits arbitrary relabelling, while a single metric would contradict the authority's primitive and substantive treatment.
research_issues.expected_discriminator: A valid source example violating every proposed necessary condition criticizes modular conditions; incompatible classifications with no shared critical question criticize an unconstrained primitive contract.
admissible_source_scope: Primary CR-1.0, Popper, and Deutsch passages distinguishing explanation from prediction and fit.
Selected domain literatures used only to construct hostile explanation and non-explanation cases.
research_issues.stop_condition: Stop when a source-bound or domain-hostile case separates the contracts, exposes a shared scope defect, or the declared material supplies no domain-general discriminator.

rivals.claim: Keep Explains primitive and require each application to publish rivals, counterexamples, and a falsifiable domain interpretation.
falsifier_conditions: Two incompatible classifications pass with no shared critical question or observable consequence.
The application can protect any output by redefining its explanandum after inspection.

rivals.claim: Supply replaceable domain modules of necessary conditions while denying that any module decides explanation in full.
falsifier_conditions: A valid source example violates every proposed necessary condition.
The module's conditions become a scalar score that silently defines Explains.

related_authority_refs.use: Constrains nearby representation and problem roles but does not supply attention or values.

source_basis.boundary_note: The target doctrine is operator-supplied; research may criticize an implementation but cannot transform it into CR-1.0 authority.

related_authority_refs.use: Provides the nearby target and lineage structure.

source_basis.boundary_note: The operator settled the direction; the representation that preserves it across inexplicit cases remains open.

related_authority_refs.use: Bounds what CR-1.0 currently calls uptake and CCP.

source_basis.boundary_note: The episode lifecycle extension is operator-supplied and remains outside the source definitions.

related_authority_refs.use: Offers provenance-subgraph machinery but no overlap identity law.

source_basis.boundary_note: Overlap and absorption are operator rules whose formal representation is unresolved.

authoritative_refs.use: Requires causal-credit treatment across design, training, stored repertoire, interaction, and reconstruction.

source_basis.boundary_note: The source fixes the burden but does not select a complete causal-credit calculus.

authoritative_refs.locator: DF-11 to DF-13, TH-7 and TH-12
authoritative_refs.use: Separates modal stable organization from any finite observed history.

source_basis.boundary_note: The non-entailment is fixed; the defeasible application evidence contract remains interpretive.

research_issue_annotations.title: Minimal causal realization of semantic roles

authoritative_refs.use: Admits inexplicit roles while requiring system-level causal use and semantic invariance.

source_basis.boundary_note: The source states necessary constraints but leaves their general empirical realization open.

authoritative_refs.use: States bridge obligations and the conditional physical-attribution consequence.

source_basis.boundary_note: The source does not provide a completed empirical bridge for an actual system.

related_authority_refs.use: Constrains inductive ascent and immunity from criticism but does not design the forge scheduler.

source_basis.boundary_note: This is a harness-design problem; AlphaXiv is a preferred discovery provider, not an authority or required implementation.

authoritative_refs.use: Treats Explains as primitive and substantive rather than prediction, usefulness, survival, or a generic score.

source_basis.boundary_note: Replaceable domain interpretations may criticize applications but cannot silently redefine the CR-1.0 primitive.
